run.access_mode: Playwright (scripts/catalog.mjs) + save reads; the 2nd win for the ad check was triggered with the debug 'Win level' (assisted)
run.scope: Feature-catalog checklists without a dedicated skill: tutorial, ads, lifecycle, accessibility (touch targets), notifications
run.summary: Tutorial, simulated ads and save-on-close all work. Several buttons are smaller than the 44 px touch-target guideline (top-bar currency buttons, store Buy buttons, in-level Pause and Speed).

coverage.notes: All 6 steps completed, including the 'tap this block' step; not shown again afterwards.
Video ad after every 2nd win without No Ads, none with No Ads; rewarded AD slot gives +1 slot only after the ad.
A purchase is still there after closing the tab immediately (saved at once).

evidence.caption: Gems in a new tab after closing mid-session

coverage.notes: Android-only (Capacitor Local Notifications); needs a device.
Not measured in this run. The game already enforces a minimum colour distance between puzzle colours in data.js (MIN_DE).

findings.title: Several buttons are below the 44 px touch-target guideline on phones (top-bar currency buttons, store Buy, in-level Pause and Speed)
steps: Measure the on-screen size of every visible button on the menu, store, settings and a level
findings.expected: At least 44x44 CSS px (Apple HIG; Android recommends 48 dp)
findings.actual: Gems/coins top-bar buttons 76x34 and 79x34; store Buy buttons 95x38 (x6); Copy player ID 77x38; in-level Pause 40x40; Speed 67x36

evidence.caption: Level: Pause (top left) and Speed (top right)

findings.suggested_fix: Grow the hit area to 44 px without changing the art, e.g. padding or an ::after hit box on these buttons.
